blurb: Guests can book permits and outfitting for canoe trips in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness and Quetico Provincial Park. Services include complete outfitting packages for fishing trips, tow services to remote entry points, shuttle services for gear and people, and winter partial rentals including fish houses and ice fishing gear. Permits and fees for wilderness entry and camping are handled by the operator if desired.
